bullets.text: Under capstone supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided product review records and used unittest to test transformations on hand-checked input examples.

Under supervision, validated SQL joins of provided product review metadata using duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules with Matplotlib.
As an individual contribution to a supervised team project, wrote Python functions to parse provided company report records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

As an individual contribution to a supervised team project, validated SQL joins of company report metadata with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized changes in group comparisons under alternative cleaning rules.
As part of a supervised research team, wrote Python functions to parse provided programming question records and used unittest to test transformations on hand-checked input examples.

Under research supervision, validated SQL joins of programming question metadata using duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
As part of a supervised research team, wrote Python functions to parse provided policy excerpt records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under research supervision, validated SQL joins of policy document metadata with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules using Matplotlib.
